issues.title: Site 3 of 3: tests for each section
issues.body:
Tests for each section: every record entry has a date, every step of the flow links to an example, and every measure says what it should do.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

`tests/`
